newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products all soften with futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all soften with futures.

text.p: NWE oil products all softened on Monday morning, largely following the IPE futures market down, dealers said.
Eurograde gasoline barges were offered at $226 fob Rotterdam for running refinery, about $2 down from Friday's close in a thin start to the week. Stored product was $1 lower.
Heating oil barges fell by around $2 as September IPE gas oil futures fell. Some sellers increased their offers to Sept IPE +50 cents fob Rotterdam.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded once at $94.50 fob Rotterdam.
